title: docs(plugin-audit): the tenantId pin's title says v16-removed, the major it was actually removed in
body:
Fixes #11502

## What

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.test.ts:1653` carried the live test name:

```
'⛔ does not resolve the v11-removed `tenantId` alias'
```

The #3290 `session.tenantId` removal shipped in the **v16** major, not v11 — there is no v11 release page at all (release pages on `main` are v9, v12–v17). One line, string literal only: `v11-removed` → `v16-removed`.

## Why v16 is the right label, not just "not v11"

Two siblings in this same package already spell the same removal correctly, which is what pins the form rather than leaving it to judgment:

| site | text |
| --- | --- |
| `src/audit-writers.ts:1205` | `was removed repo-wide in the v16 major (#3290)` |
| `src/audit-writers.test.ts:1560` | `deprecated alias (#3280) REMOVED repo-wide in the v16 major (#3290)` |

The second is the doc comment on this very test's own `describe` block, 93 lines above the title being fixed — so the title was the one site in the file disagreeing with its own header.

## Scope

Title text only. **Zero assertions move** — the diff is one string literal; no fixture, subject, `expect` or session shape changes. The pin still fires on exactly what it fired on before: a session in the removed dialect must not resolve, and `organization_id` stays `null`.

Deliberately **not** touched, per the card's fence:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md:287` and `:387` still say `v11`. Published changelogs are append-only history and are out of scope here — see the #9734 maintainer ruling (2026-08-22) for the only authorized changelog edit in this family. Reported to the dispatching seat for adjudication rather than fixed silently.
- The behaviourally-inert `scripts/check-org-identifier.mjs` fixture sites stay with #9872 (devx lane).

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, not a `.changeset/*.md`. This PR edits one test title and publishes nothing — `check:published-files` is green and no package's shipped output changes. That is the case `.github/workflows/lint.yml:1467` describes as "the textbook `skip-changeset` case — such a PR releases nothing, so by the workflow's own prescription it takes the label."

## Verification — at `2b0c52dbec`, clean tree

All heavy steps serialized through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; every exit code captured before any pipe.

The renamed test executes and passes under its new name (`--reporter=verbose`, not inferred from a suite total):

```
✓ src/audit-writers.test.ts > audit writers — the writer reads the session key
  the engine emits (#9516, #3290) > ⛔ does not resolve the v16-removed `tenantId` alias 0ms
```

| step | result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-audit^...' build` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` | exit 0 — **19 files, 313 tests passed** |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck` | exit 0 |
| `check:nul-bytes` · `check:slot-lookup` · `check:query-options-erasure` · `check:where-matcher` · `check:engine-double-contract` · `check:type-check-coverage` | exit 0 |
| `check:cross-package-test-inputs` · `check:test-source-alias` · `check:type-source-resolution` · `check:published-files` | exit 0 |
| `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs` · `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` · `docs-audit/check-affected-docs.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `check:i18n` | exit 0 — after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli`; its first run was `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (unbuilt CLI), which is NOT MEASURED, so the CLI was built and the gate re-run for a real reading |

Gate families derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against the actual diff, not from the dispatch list.

**Not measured locally:** `check:type-check-debt --re-measure`, which refuses on a worktree without the whole workspace built. The package's own `tsc --noEmit` is green, and a string literal inside an existing test file already in that program cannot move a per-entry count — but the ratchet itself is left to CI rather than claimed here.
